Read [the security skill](../../.agents/skills/powerbi-security-governance/SKILL.md) and use only approved personas and rules. Separate source, model, report, workspace, app, and sharing controls. Test allowed and denied cases, record evidence, and stop for clarification when access or compliance requirements are ambiguous.
